idea-plugin.name: VPS Graph
idea-plugin.description: Explore what is running on one Linux VPS and how its infrastructure connects. VPS Graph performs manual, read-only SSH scans and presents sanitized Docker, Compose, Caddy, Systemd, listener, and local change-history data without a cloud backend or remote management surface.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Initial public beta.

  • Read-only SSH host discovery with strict known_hosts verification.
  • Optional sanitized Docker, Compose, Caddy, Systemd, and listener discovery.
  • Local infrastructure snapshots and evidence-qualified Changes history.
  • First-run setup guidance, remembered connection fields, and local Disconnect.
